items.note: The prompt asks whether the July Pro price increase (49 to 69 USD) drove Pro churn, and says to focus on that rather than general churn.
It says to exclude every row where is_trial = yes.
It says to exclude every row whose email ends in @ourco.test, describing these as internal test accounts.
It defines churn as having a cancel_month, and says an empty cancel_month means the account has not churned.
It says the summary is for the CEO, and the output section is addressed to the CEO.
It asks for a summary of at most 5 bullets and no table.
It asks for one suggested chart that says what to plot, with no chart built and no chart code.
It says the summary must state how confident the conclusion is, given the small sample.
